name: Ultra-Low Latency Institutional Crypto Order Matching Engine
objective: Architect a deterministic, high-throughput central limit order book (CLOB) and execution venue capable of processing 2,000,000 order cancellations and placements per second with sub-100-microsecond deterministic matching latency.
constraints: Deterministic execution order with strictly non-blocking lock-free single-writer principle (LMAX Disruptor pattern)
Sub-100-microsecond p99.9 order placement to ack latency under peak market volatility
Continuous state snapshotting and write-ahead logging (WAL) ensuring zero trade loss across failovers
Real-time WebSocket / FIX 4.4 / ITCH / OUCH feed distribution for market makers
Strict SOC2 Type II and MiCA regulatory audit compliance

components.name: Institutional FIX / Binary Ingress Gateway
components.responsibility: Terminates co-located direct market access (DMA) cross-connects, performs wire-speed token bucket pre-trade credit checks, and sequences raw orders into hardware ring buffers.

components.name: Single-Threaded Deterministic CLOB Matching Core
components.responsibility: Executes price-time priority order matching without lock contention, generating deterministic fill and cancel events onto the output journal.

components.name: Microsecond State Machine Replicator
components.technology: Aeron Cluster / Raft State Consensus over Solarflare EF_VI
components.responsibility: Replicates order matching journal across hot-standby node cluster with zero garbage collection pauses and deterministic replay.

components.name: L2 / L3 Market Data Broadcaster
components.responsibility: Aggregates matched trades and order book depth snapshots, streaming tick-by-tick market data to institutional algorithmic traders.

components.name: Post-Trade Clearing & Custody Ledger
components.responsibility: Processes double-entry financial settlement, margin collateral balance updates, and cold-storage withdrawal authorizations.

security_threats: SPOOFING: Stolen API secret keys executing fraudulent wash trading and liquidity draining
TAMPERING: Clock manipulation altering timestamp precedence on order arrival queues
DENIAL_OF_SERVICE: High-frequency quote-stuffing attacks exhausting socket buffer memory
